analysis_type: Conservative full-ellipsoid native Fourier bounds from exact linear decomposition, marginal support and Lipschitz period remainders, intersected with the stage-47 independent envelopes and checked against all stage-50 feasible candidates; no joint-global-optimum or probability claim

decomposition_rule.identity: Write f(theta,x)=f_c(x)+v_c(x)^T delta_c+R(theta,x), where v_c contains the intercept and center-period trigonometric values and R contains b5,b6,b8,b9 multiplied by the corresponding actual-minus-center sine or cosine differences
decomposition_rule.linear_support: Bound the linear term by radius*sqrt(v_c^T*C_cc*v_c), using the marginal coefficient block because periods remain free in the full ellipsoid. Do not substitute the fixed-period Schur-complement slice matrix
decomposition_rule.period_support: For each period p in {b4,b7}, use delta_p_max=radius*sqrt(C_pp) and p_min=center_p-delta_p_max>0 from the stage-47 positive-period certificate
decomposition_rule.phase_remainder: For each month x and period p, use D_p(x)=min(2,2*pi*abs(x)*delta_p_max/(center_p*p_min)); both sine and cosine differences are bounded by D_p(x) through Lipschitz continuity and the universal cap 2
decomposition_rule.amplitude_caps: For each harmonic coefficient c, use abs(c)<=abs(center_c)+radius*sqrt(C_cc). Define A4=abs(b5_center)+abs(b6_center)+radius*(sqrt(C_55)+sqrt(C_66)) and A7 analogously for b8,b9
decomposition_rule.remainder_support: Use abs(R(theta,x))<=A4*D4(x)+A7*D7(x). This follows from the exact decomposition, triangle inequality and phase bound, not from a Taylor model substitution
decomposition_rule.alternative_bound: Use f_c(x) plus or minus radius*sqrt(v_c^T*C_cc*v_c)+A4*D4(x)+A7*D7(x), with high-precision outward rounding. This is a conservative full-ellipsoid alternative, not a joint global optimum
decomposition_rule.intersection: Intersect the alternative with the stage-47 independent envelope by taking the maximum lower bound and minimum upper bound. Require a nonempty interval and center-prediction containment; never replace the historical baseline

candidate_rule.candidate_source: Use all 672 candidate evaluations from the stage-50 full covariance-support directions without adding, removing or reordering them
candidate_rule.feasibility_gate: Require the stage-50 receipt to pass, all candidate directions to remain feasible with quadratic form 16, and all candidates to remain inside the stage-47 independent envelope
candidate_rule.alternative_check: Require every candidate prediction to lie inside the alternative full-ellipsoid bound
candidate_rule.intersection_check: Require every candidate prediction to lie inside the intersection bound
candidate_rule.scope: Candidate checks are implementation-consistency tests, not the analytic proof and not a global optimizer or independent physical experiment

comparison_rule.alternative_comparison: Classify every alternative width as tighter, wider or equal to the stage-47 independent width without suppressing wider alternatives
comparison_rule.intersection_comparison: Report intersection width ratio and reduction for every month. A tighter intersection is allowed but not assumed; unchanged intersections remain valid
comparison_rule.nonempty_gate: Require all intersections to be nonempty and every center and candidate prediction to remain inside; any contradiction invalidates the implementation rather than weakening the bound
comparison_rule.no_optimum: Neither the alternative nor the intersection is claimed to be the full nonlinear global optimum

numerical_rule.engine: Use 80-digit mpmath arithmetic and the frozen native model, support and outward-rounding implementations
numerical_rule.outward_rounding: Apply the 1e-24 relative margin and nextafter outward conversion for certified lower and upper values
numerical_rule.certificate_class: High-precision numerical conservative interval, not exact rational algebra
numerical_rule.positive_period_gate: Reject non-positive period minima instead of applying the phase denominator formula
numerical_rule.historical_preservation: Do not rewrite stage-47 or stage-50 inputs, receipts, reports, figures or Word documents

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生ENSO全椭球Lipschitz交集_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, changed centers, covariance matrices, folds, period bounds or post-hoc candidate directions
No use of the fixed-period Schur slice matrix for the full linear-support term
No assumption that the alternative is tighter everywhere or that every intersection must strictly tighten
No hiding of wider alternatives, unchanged intersections or candidate violations
No calling candidate checks the analytic proof or a global optimization procedure
No probability, confidence, posterior, calibrated-coverage, physical-period or independent-experiment claim
No exact rational-certificate claim for high-precision numerical intervals
No replacement or rewriting of historical baseline files
